nativeBaseline.reference: native list of selected items and native remove buttons

library: Preserve item identity and focus after removal; expose native button semantics.
consumer: Author item-specific removal names and decide whether removal is accepted.

notes: Runtime ports preserve authored item names and move focus only after the focused removal control actually disappears. Next surviving eligible removal control, then previous, then the programmatically focusable group is the fallback; an external consumer-selected focus target wins. Consumer owns item identity and accepted removal. Manual evidence remains open.
Audit mapping is provisional; not a conformance claim.
